generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
1.For Reserved category works, valid caste certificate issued by the Competent Authority Valid caste certificate shall be uploaded

2.For Reserved category works valid Domicile/Residential certificate during the year issued by the Competent Authority for residing in the State of Karnataka for more than 10 years (Last more than 10 Years) Valid Domicile/Residential certificate during the year shall be uploaded
3.Valid copy of constitution or legal status of the bidder (Company/firm registration certificate with firm address (KPWD/CPWD Class-II and above) proof shall be uploaded)

4.Achieved in at least One financial year a minimum turnover of Rs.49.15 Lakhs (Excluding GST) Financial turnover certificate from (FY 2021 22 to 2025 26) certified by Charted Accountant (with valid UDIN No) shall be furnished. Updated to the FY in which the tenders are invited. Financial turnover of previous years shall be given a weight of 10 Percent per year to bring them to the price level of the FY in which the tenders are invited. Financial Turnover certificates from FY 2021-22 to 2025-26 certified by Charted Accountant (with valid UDIN No.) shall be uploaded.

5.Satisfactorily completed as a prime contractor for at least any construction work in the Central Government Departments or state Government Departments or Public Sector Units PSUs to an extent of value not less than Rs.12.29 Lakhs (excluding GST) as a single work. Work done certificates issued by not below the rank of the Executive Engineer shall be furnished. Work done certificates issued by not below the rank of the Executive Engineer shall be uploaded.

6(A)The statements showing the value of existing commitments and on-going works as well as the stipulated period of completion remaining for each of the works listed in the form of statement. The statements showing existing commitments and ongoing works certificates should be countersigned by the Employer in charge, not below the rank of an Executive Engineer or equivalent shall be uploaded

6(B)Information on works for which tenders have been submitted as on the date of this tender in the form of statement. The statements showing the works for which tenders already submitted shall be uploaded

7.Reports on the financial standing of the tenderer, such as profit and loss statements and auditors reports for the last five years (FY 2021-22 to 2025-26)The profit and loss statements and auditors reports for the last five years (FY 2021-22 to 2025-26) shall be uploaded

8.Qualification and experience of the key technical and management personnel in permanent employment with the tenderer and those that are proposed to be deployed on this contract. Degree or Diploma Civil Engineer certificate of technical & declaration of employment with details, (if the bidder has not technical qualified) shall be uploaded.
9.Name, address, telephone, e-mail, and fax numbers of the Tenderers bank. Tenderers bankers (details) who may provide references (if contacted by the Employer) shall be uploaded.
10.Permanent Account Number and GST Registration Certificate. PAN & GST Document proof shall be uploaded

11.Contractor should be EPF & ESI registration certificate EPF & ESI registration certificate shall be uploaded. (if EPF not, Self-declaration should be furnished with satisfactory reasons for non-applicable of EPF)

12.Contractor should be executed the work in live sub-stations satisfactorily (For awareness of doing work in live sub stations since the said work is to be carry out in live Electric substation zone). (Work experience certificate format shall be uploaded along with tender documents) Work experience certificate should be issued from the cadre of not less than the rank of the Executive Engineer duly mentioning for the last 5 years, (2021-22 to 2025-26) shall be uploaded.

13.Bidder should upload self-declaration for his firm being responsible for any fake and false declarations. (Undertaking format shall be uploaded along with tender documents). self-declaration certificate duly mentioning the date after the publish of this notification with original signature (xerox copy of the signature will not be accepted) shall be uploaded.

14.Bidder should upload self declaration that his firm is not in BLACK list of any Govt. organization/ Govt. undertaking sectors/PSU. (Undertaking format shall be uploaded along with tender documents). self-declaration certificate duly mentioning the date after the publish of this notification with original signature (xerox copy of the signature will not be accepted) shall be uploaded.

15.The bidder should upload detailed information on any litigation or arbitration arising out of contracts completed or under execution by it over the last five years in any organization. A history of awards involving litigations against the bidder or any part or JV (Joint Venture) may result in rejection of bid.(Undertaking format shall be uploaded along with tender documents) self-declaration certificate duly mentioning the date after the publish of this notification with original signature (xerox copy of the signature will not be accepted) shall be uploaded.
16.Tenderers who meet available tender capacity is more than the total tender value. The available tender capacity calculation sheet shall be uploaded.
